# AI Cost Audit

> Cut 70–90% off your LLM/AI API bill with verified model routing. Free open-source CLI audit, paid gateway setup. GDPR-aware by design.

## Documentation
- [Landing page](https://ai.acan.ccwu.cc/): Full overview, ROI calculator, data-residency controls, FAQ
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/huocan007/ai-cost-audit): Open-source CLI audit tool (ai_cost_audit.py) and documentation
- [Cheapest LLMs 2026](https://ai.acan.ccwu.cc/cheapest-llms-2026.html): Verified per-million-token price ranking of the 7 cheapest LLMs, with official sources

## Key facts
- Savings: 70–90% on routine LLM calls by routing to cheaper models (DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen) instead of GPT/Claude
- Integration: change one line (base_url) to an OpenAI-compatible LiteLLM gateway; no application rewrite
- Pricing: free CLI; one-time setup $800–1,500; monthly tuning retainer $200–900
- Data residency: BYOK, prompts never stored, three routes (cloud Asia / Western flagship / self-hosted)
- Compliance: EU PII should not use the Asia route (no GDPR adequacy); self-hosted or Western for regulated data
- Gateway: self-hosted LiteLLM (Apache-2.0), open-source and auditable
